cases.name: Library framing example
cases.purpose: Basic example used in playgrond and spec examples.

cases.name: reframe w/extra CURIE value.
cases.purpose: Append extra values to output.

cases.name: reframe (null)
cases.purpose: Do not match without a matching @type

cases.name: reframe (type)
cases.purpose: Multiple matches on @type.

cases.name: reframe (explicit)
cases.purpose: If property is not in frame, and explicit is true, do not add any values for property to output.

cases.name: reframe (non-explicit)
cases.purpose: Unless the explicit is false, processors append extra values to output.

cases.name: input has multiple types
cases.purpose: If property is a keyword, processors add property and objects to output.

cases.name: array framing cases
cases.purpose: Various cases showing array output for @container: @set, and non-embedding of node values if @embed: false.

cases.name: default value
cases.purpose: Processors MUST skip property and property frame if property frame contains @omitDefault with a value of true. Processors MUST add property to output with a new dictionary having a property @preserve and a value that is a copy of the value of @default in frame if it exists, or the string @null otherwise.

cases.name: property CURIE conflict
cases.purpose: (Not really framing) A term looking like a CURIE becomes a CURIE when framing/compacting if defined as such in frame/context in json-ld-1.0.

cases.name: @embed true/false
cases.purpose: @embed within a frame controls the object embed flag when processing that frame (true and false values) in json-ld-1.0 mode.

cases.name: Array frame
cases.purpose: Multiple values for @type in frame match different nodes having one or the other type. With @embed false, nodes are serialized as multiple array values of @graph.

cases.name: Replace existing embed
cases.purpose: An empty frame matches all objects, even if embedded, causing them to be serialized under @graph.

cases.name: Replace existing embed on 2nd pass
cases.purpose: An embedded node which matches the top-level frame (on @type) is framed under @graph and continues to be embedded. Other nodes continue to be embedded.

cases.name: Replace deeply-nested embed
cases.purpose: Torture test.

cases.name: Use @type in ducktype filter
cases.purpose: Match if node has a @type property and frame has a @type property containing only an empty dictionary.

cases.name: Non-flat input
cases.purpose: Framing flattens expanded input, allowing for deeply embedded input to be re-framed.

cases.name: no frame @context but @graph output
cases.purpose: Set framing context to the value of @context from frame, if it exists, or to a new empty context, otherwise.

cases.name: Resources can be re-embedded again in each top-level frame match
cases.purpose: @type matching matches nodes at top-level, and embedding causes them be embedded where referenced.

cases.name: Blank nodes in an array
cases.purpose: Empty frame matches all nodes at top-level, and repeats where embedded in json-ld-1.0 mode.

cases.name: Blank nodes in @type
cases.purpose: Empty frame matches all nodes at top-level, and repeats where embedded (with list content) in json-ld-1.0 mode.

cases.name: Match on @id
cases.purpose: Match if node and frame both have the same @id property.

cases.name: No match on []
cases.purpose: No match if node has a property where frame has an empty array for that same property.

cases.name: match on any common properties if @requireAll: false
cases.purpose: Match if @requireAll is false and both node and frame contain common non-keyword properties of any value.

cases.name: @requireAll with missing values and @default
cases.purpose: Match if @requireAll is true and frame contains a non-keyword key not present in node, where the value is a JSON object containing only the key @default with any value.

cases.name: explicitly excludes unframed properties (@explicit: true)
cases.purpose: If property is not in frame, and explicit is true, processors must not add any values for property to output.

cases.name: non-existent framed properties create null property
cases.purpose: Recursively, replace all key-value pairs in compacted results where the key is @preserve with the value from the key-pair. If the value from the key-pair is @null, replace the value with null.

cases.name: embed matched frames with @reverse
cases.purpose: If frame has the property @reverse, then for each reverse property and sub frame that are the values of @reverse in frame.

cases.name: embed matched frames with reversed property
cases.purpose: If frame has the property @reverse, then for each reverse property and sub frame that are the values of @reverse in frame.

cases.name: @embed @always/@never
cases.purpose: @embed within a frame controls the object embed flag when processing that frame (@always and @never values).

cases.name: match none @type match
cases.purpose: Do not match objects with @type, if frame uses @type: [].

cases.name: single @id match
cases.purpose: Match on a specific node with frame uses @id.

cases.name: multiple @id match
cases.purpose: Match on a specific node with frame uses @id with an array of IRIs.

cases.name: wildcard and match none
cases.purpose: Match/reject properties using both wildcard and match none.

cases.name: matches a deep node pattern
cases.purpose: Node patterns that don't match all levels, don't match top level.

cases.name: matches exact value pattern
cases.purpose: Value objects matching value patterns are output, others are filtered.

cases.name: matches wildcard @value in value pattern
cases.purpose: Value objects matching value patterns are output, others are filtered.

cases.name: matches wildcard @type in value pattern
cases.purpose: Value objects matching value patterns are output, others are filtered.

cases.name: matches wildcard @language in value pattern
cases.purpose: Value objects matching value patterns are output, others are filtered.

cases.name: matches match none @type in value pattern
cases.purpose: Value objects matching value patterns are output, others are filtered.

cases.name: matches match none @language in value pattern
cases.purpose: Value objects matching value patterns are output, others are filtered.

cases.name: matches some @value in value pattern
cases.purpose: Value objects matching value patterns are output, others are filtered.

cases.name: matches some @type in value pattern
cases.purpose: Value objects matching value patterns are output, others are filtered.

cases.name: matches some @language in value pattern
cases.purpose: Value objects matching value patterns are output, others are filtered.

cases.name: excludes non-matched values in value pattern
cases.purpose: Value objects matching value patterns are output, others are filtered.

cases.name: Merge graphs if no outer @graph is used
cases.purpose: Unless @graph exists at the top level, framing uses merged node objects in json-ld-1.0 mode.

cases.name: Frame default graph if outer @graph is used
cases.purpose: If @graph exists at the top level, framing uses the default graph.

cases.name: Merge one graph and preserve another
cases.purpose: @graph used within a property value frames embedded values from a named graph.

cases.name: Merge one graph and deep preserve another
cases.purpose: @graph used within a property value frames embedded values from a named graph in json-ld-1.0 mode.

cases.name: Compacting values of @preserve
cases.purpose: When compacting the value of a property using @preserve, use the term definition for term to properly compact the value of @preserve.

cases.name: @id must not include a blank node identifier
cases.purpose: Node matching does not consider blank nodes.

cases.name: @type must not include a blank node identifier
cases.purpose: Node matching does not consider blank nodes.

cases.name: Out of range @embed value
cases.purpose: Any other value for @embed is invalid and indicates that an invalid @embed value error has been detected and processing is aborted.

cases.name: Framing list with mixed values
cases.purpose: Framing list values which are mixed.

cases.name: Frame matching on matching value in list
cases.purpose: Lists match on any matching value.

cases.name: Frame matching on any matching value in list
cases.purpose: Lists match on any matching value.

cases.name: Frame matching with no matching value in list
cases.purpose: Lists match on any matching value.

cases.name: @embed: @last replaces previous embed values with node reference
cases.purpose: Verify that within a matched node, by default only the last reference will be embedded in json-ld-1.0 mode.

cases.name: @embed: @once only embeds first value with node reference
cases.purpose: Verify that within a matched node and @embed: @first, by only the first reference will be embedded.

cases.name: Matching embedded nodes with @default
cases.purpose: Verify that embedded nodes match with @default and a wildcard @id.

cases.name: An array with a single value remains an array if container is @set.
cases.purpose: Cleaning up @preserve/@null does not violate container: @set.

cases.name: Using @null in @default.
cases.purpose: @null may be used as an @default value and is preserved in output.

cases.name: Using @default in @type.
cases.purpose: @type may have a default value.

cases.purpose: Value reference matching.

cases.purpose: List value matching.

cases.name: Merge @type from different graphs
cases.purpose: When merging nodes, ensure that @type values from each node are retained.
